flow: Do not open a VAR channel until the product sells and converts direct, because no partner will sell it better than you can.
Sign only partners you can activate, not 200 logos with 195 sitting idle, and mine your existing user base for agencies already using the product.
Offer free training, no joining fees and tiered margins such as 10/20/30 percent, pricing partner payouts against the stages of a $21,500 direct CAC.
Run deal registration and lead distribution through PRM, keeping partner-submitted data in separate CRM fields instead of letting partners edit the CRM directly.
Publish implementation ballparks, provide budgetary numbers up front, and require a written markup definition and a broken-out tax line on every quote.
Track go-live into production and active users for every customer from purchase, since failing to go live is the primary non-renewal driver.
